EnterpriseBench Corecraft: Training Generalizable Agents on High-Fidelity RL Environments

paper.arxiv.2602.16179

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2602.16179v5. Corecraft1000/150training split and evolving benchmark footnote establish a distinct training study. It remains linked conceptually to the earlier hierarchy study without claiming independent replication or family duplication. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The current frontier benchmark uses tasks added after training and is distinct from the training-time evaluation split; testing other base model families, more epochs and degraded-environment ablations remains future work.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The Corecraft training study fine-tunes GLM 4.6 with GRPO using 16 rollouts per prompt and LM-judged rubric fractions as dense rewards; strict task pass rate separately requires all criteria to be satisfied.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Training uses 1, 000 tasks and 150 randomly held-out evaluation tasks in one fictional retailer world with more than 2, 500 entities, 14 entity types and 23 MCP tools; the base model is a 357 B mixture of experts with 32 B active parameters.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Table 3 reports the trained GLM 4.6 task pass rate increasing from 25.37% to 36.76% afterone epoch, an 11.39 percentage-point gain on the held-out split available during training.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Table 4 reports Toolathlon transfer accuracy rising from 18.8% to 25.6% and tau2-Bench Retail from 68.7% to 76.1% after Corecraft training; these are separate external benchmarks and differ from Corecraft task pass rate.
